title: Watch rebuilds report/handle/activity readers per frame; caches never hit
description:
localStatusModel constructs AttemptReports/WorkerHandles/TranscriptActivity on every call and watchLive calls it every interval, so each 2s frame spawns git per settled tick and walks the executor state dir. TestReportCachesPerAttempt holds one reader across calls, so it passes without testing the production wiring.
